props.name: once
props.description: Keep the content shown after its first reveal. Default true.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Share of the element that must be visible, 0 to 1. Default 0.2.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: Grows or shrinks the view, e.g. `"0px 0px -10% 0px"` to wait a little longer.

props.name: distance
props.description: px that `rise`, `drop` and the slides travel. Default 24.

props.name: stagger
props.description: ms between direct children; each child animates on its own.
